purchase_order_approved_matches_status.name: purchase_order_approved_matches_status
purchase_order_approved_matches_status.value: ("purchase_order"."status"::text <> 'draft' or "purchase_order"."approved_at" is null) and ("purchase_order"."status"::text not in ('approved', 'partly_received', 'received', 'closed') or "purchase_order"."approved_at" is not null)

stock_movement_return_matches_kind.name: stock_movement_return_matches_kind
stock_movement_return_matches_kind.value: ("stock_movement"."kind"::text <> 'sale_return' or "stock_movement"."sale_return_id" is not null) and ("stock_movement"."sale_return_id" is null or "stock_movement"."kind"::text in ('sale_return', 'adjustment'))

stock_request_fulfilled_matches_status.name: stock_request_fulfilled_matches_status
stock_request_fulfilled_matches_status.value: ("stock_request"."status"::text = 'fulfilled') = ("stock_request"."fulfilled_at" is not null and "stock_request"."transfer_id" is not null)
